KASHSHAF:102:1/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:102:1/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:102:1/r1.claim: The sūra is Meccan and has eight verses.

KASHSHAF:102:1/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:102:1/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:102:1/r2.claim: Alhāhu ʿan and the related form aqhāhu mean that something distracted or occupied him.
KASHSHAF:102:1/r2.anchor: ألهاه عن كذا وأقهاه : إذا شغله

KASHSHAF:102:1/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:102:1/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:102:1/r3.claim: Takāthur is competing and boasting about abundance, with each group claiming to outnumber the other.

KASHSHAF:102:1/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:102:1/r4.speaker: unspecified report
KASHSHAF:102:1/r4.claim: A report says Banū ʿAbd Manāf and Banū Sahm boasted over their numbers; after ʿAbd Manāf prevailed among the living, Sahm proposed counting the dead, among whom Sahm then prevailed.
KASHSHAF:102:1/r4.anchor: روي أن بني عبد مناف وبني سهم تفاخروا أيهم أكثر عدداً ، فكثرهم بنو عبد مناف

KASHSHAF:102:1/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:102:1/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:102:1/r5.claim: The people competed over the living until they exhausted their number, then turned to the graves to compete over the dead; describing this as visiting graves is sarcastic.
KASHSHAF:102:1/r5.anchor: عبر عن بلوغهم ذكر الموتى بزيارة المقابر تهكماً بهم

MAWARDI:102:1/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:102:1/r1.speaker: author
MAWARDI:102:1/r1.anchor:
مقدمة السورة:
سورة التكاثر
مكية
بسم الله الرحمان الرحيم

MAWARDI:102:1/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:102:1/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI:102:1/r2.claim: Alhakum can mean occupied or made forgetful: the distraction keeps people from obeying their Lord and worshipping their Creator.
MAWARDI:102:1/r2.anchor:
في { ألهاكم } وجهان :
أحدهما : شغلكم .
الثاني : أنساكم ،   ومعناه ألهاكم عن طاعة ربكم

MAWARDI:102:1/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:102:1/r3.speaker: الحسن
MAWARDI:102:1/r3.claim: Al-Hasan says the competition is over wealth and children.
MAWARDI:102:1/r3.anchor: أحدها : التكاثر بالمال والأولاد ،   قاله الحسن .

MAWARDI:102:1/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:102:1/r4.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI:102:1/r4.claim: Qatada says it is boasting in clans and tribes.
MAWARDI:102:1/r4.anchor: الثاني : التفاخر بالعشائر والقبائل ،   قاله قتادة .

MAWARDI:102:1/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:102:1/r5.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI:102:1/r5.claim: Al-Dahhak says it is preoccupation with livelihood and trade.
MAWARDI:102:1/r5.anchor: الثالث : التشاغل بالمعاش والتجارة ،   قاله الضحاك{[3328]} .

NASAFI:102:1/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:102:1/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI:102:1/r1.claim: Surat al-Takathur is Meccan and has eight verses.
NASAFI:102:1/r1.anchor:
مقدمة السورة:
سورة التكاثر مكية ،   وهى ثماني آيات .
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

NASAFI:102:1/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:102:1/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI:102:1/r2.claim: Competition and boasting over having more wealth and children distracted people from obeying God.
NASAFI:102:1/r2.anchor: شغلكم التباري في الكثرة والتباهي بها في الأموال والأولاد عن طاعة الله

QURTUBI:102:1/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI:102:1/r1.claim: The sura is Meccan according to all exegetes, though al-Bukhari reports it as Medinan; it has eight verses.
QURTUBI:102:1/r1.anchor: وهي مكية في قول جميع المفسرين ،   وروى البخاري أنها مدنية ،   وهي ثماني آيات .

QURTUBI:102:1/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI:102:1/r2.claim: Alhākum means “occupied you”; the word can also mean “made you forget.”
QURTUBI:102:1/r2.anchor: ألهاكم : شغلكم .   قال : فألهيتها عن ذي تمائم مُغْيِلِ{[16331]} أي شغلكم

QURTUBI:102:1/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r3.speaker: امرؤ القيس
QURTUBI:102:1/r3.claim: Imru al-Qays’s line uses فألهيتها to mean that he occupied or distracted her, illustrating the verb’s sense.
QURTUBI:102:1/r3.anchor: قال : فألهيتُها عن ذي تمائم مُغْيِلِ{[16331]} أي شغلكم

QURTUBI:102:1/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI:102:1/r4.claim: Rivalry in wealth and numbers distracts from obedience to God until people die and are buried.
QURTUBI:102:1/r4.anchor: أي شغلكم المباهاة بكثرة المال والعدد عن طاعة الله ،   حتى متم ودفنتم في المقابر .

QURTUBI:102:1/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r5.speaker: ابن عباس والحسن
QURTUBI:102:1/r5.claim: Ibn Abbas and al-Hasan take the rivalry to concern wealth and children.
QURTUBI:102:1/r5.anchor: " التكاثر "  : أي من الأموال والأولاد ،   قاله ابن عباس والحسن .

QURTUBI:102:1/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r6.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI:102:1/r6.claim: Qatada interprets it as boasting about tribes and clans.
QURTUBI:102:1/r6.anchor: وقال قتادة : أي التفاخر بالقبائل والعشائر .

QURTUBI:102:1/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r7.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI:102:1/r7.claim: Al-Dahhak interprets it as being preoccupied with livelihood and trade.
QURTUBI:102:1/r7.anchor: وقال الضحاك : أي ألهاكم التشاغل بالمعاش والتجارة .

QURTUBI:102:1/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI:102:1/r8.claim: Lahiytu ʿan something means to turn away from it and forget it; alhā means to occupy, and lahā bihi means to divert or amuse someone.
QURTUBI:102:1/r8.anchor: يقال : لهيت عن كذا ( بالكسر ) ألهى لهيا ولهيانا : إذا سلوت عنه ،   وتركت ذكره ،

QURTUBI:102:1/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI:102:1/r9.claim: Takāthur is mutual vying or trying to outnumber one another.
QURTUBI:102:1/r9.anchor: وألهاه : أي شغله .   ولهاه به تلهية أي علله .   والتكاثر : المكاثرة .

QURTUBI:102:1/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r10.speaker: مقاتل وقتادة وغيرهما
QURTUBI:102:1/r10.claim: One occasion report says the sura came down about Jews boasting that they outnumbered other groups, a rivalry that distracted them until they died astray.
QURTUBI:102:1/r10.anchor: قال مقاتل وقتادة وغيرهما : نزلت في اليهود حين قالوا : نحن أكثر من بني فلان ،

QURTUBI:102:1/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r11.speaker: ابن زيد
QURTUBI:102:1/r11.claim: Ibn Zayd says the sura was revealed about one clan of the Ansar.
QURTUBI:102:1/r11.anchor: وقال ابن زيد : نزلت في فخذ من الأنصار .

QURTUBI:102:1/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r12.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل والكلبي
QURTUBI:102:1/r12.claim: Ibn Abbas, Muqatil, and al-Kalbi say two Quraysh clans, Banu Abd Manaf and Banu Sahm, competed over notables and numbers; first the living, then the dead.
QURTUBI:102:1/r12.anchor: وقال ابن عباس ومقاتل والكلبي : نزلت في حيين من قريش : بني عبد مناف ،   وبني سهم ،

QURTUBI:102:1/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r13.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI:102:1/r13.claim: Sa‘id reports from Qatada that the clans boasted about their numbers while their members died off until all became people of the graves.
QURTUBI:102:1/r13.anchor: وروى سعيد عن قتادة قال : كانوا يقولون نحن أكثر من بني فلان ،   ونحن أعد من بني فلان ،

QURTUBI:102:1/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r14.speaker: عمرو بن دينار
QURTUBI:102:1/r14.claim: Amr ibn Dinar swore that the sura was revealed concerning merchants.
QURTUBI:102:1/r14.anchor: وعن عمرو بن دينار : حلف أن هذه السورة نزلت في التجار .

QURTUBI:102:1/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r15.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI:102:1/r15.claim: Shayban reports Qatada’s view that the sura was revealed concerning the People of the Book.
QURTUBI:102:1/r15.anchor: وعن شيبان عن قتادة قال : نزلت في أهل الكتاب .

QURTUBI:102:1/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r16.speaker: author
QURTUBI:102:1/r16.claim: Qurtubi says the verse applies broadly to all the groups and causes mentioned, as well as others.
QURTUBI:102:1/r16.anchor: قلت : الآية تعم جميع ما ذكر وغيره .   وفي صحيح مسلم عن مطرف عن أبيه قال : أتيت النبي

QURTUBI:102:1/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r17.speaker: مطرف عن أبيه
QURTUBI:102:1/r17.claim: Mutarrif’s father recounts the Prophet saying that only what a person consumed, wore out, or gave in charity remains his; the rest is left behind.
QURTUBI:102:1/r17.anchor: يقول ابن آدم : مالي مالي ! وهل لك يا ابن آدم من مالك إلا ما أكلت فأفنيت ،   أو لبست فأبليت ،   أو تصدقت فأمضيت

QURTUBI:102:1/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r18.speaker: أنس بن مالك
QURTUBI:102:1/r18.claim: Anas reports the Prophet saying a person with one valley of gold would want two, and nothing fills his mouth but dust; God accepts repentance.
QURTUBI:102:1/r18.anchor: وروى البخاري عن ابن شهاب : أخبرني أنس بن مالك أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال :  " لو أن لابن آدم واديا من ذهب ،

QURTUBI:102:1/r19.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r19.speaker: ثابت عن أنس عن أبي
QURTUBI:102:1/r19.claim: Thabit reports from Anas, from Ubay, that they used to regard the saying about a second valley of gold as Qur’an until this sura was revealed.
QURTUBI:102:1/r19.anchor: قال ثابت عن أنس عن أبي : كنا نرى هذا من القرآن ،   حتى نزلت { ألهاكم التكاثر } .

QURTUBI:102:1/r20.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r20.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI:102:1/r20.claim: Ibn al-Arabi calls the preceding report sound and eloquent, and says it escaped the attention of exegetes.
QURTUBI:102:1/r20.anchor: قال ابن العربي : وهذا نص صحيح مليح ،   غاب عن أهل التفسير فجهلوا ،   والحمد لله على المعرفة .

QURTUBI:102:1/r21.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:102:1/r21.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI:102:1/r21.claim: Ibn Abbas reports the Prophet explained rivalry in wealth as gathering unlawfully, withholding its due, and storing it in containers.
QURTUBI:102:1/r21.anchor: وقال ابن عباس : قرأ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم { ألهاكم التكاثر } ،   قال : ( تكاثر الأموال : جمعها من غير حقها ،

RAZI:102:1/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r1.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r1.claim: Ihlāʾ means turning someone toward amusement; amusement follows desire, and turning to one thing entails turning away from another.
RAZI:102:1/r1.anchor: المسألة الأولى : الإلهاء الصرف إلى اللهو . واللهو الانصراف إلى ما يدعو إليه الهوى

RAZI:102:1/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r2.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r2.claim: In ordinary Arabic, a person who says something distracted him means that it made him forget and occupied him.
RAZI:102:1/r2.anchor: ألهاني فلان عن كذا أي أنساني وشغلني

RAZI:102:1/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r3.speaker: الزبير
RAZI:102:1/r3.claim: A report says al-Zubayr would leave his conversation when he heard thunder; the phrase لهى عن حديثه means he abandoned and turned away from it.
RAZI:102:1/r3.anchor: أن الزبير كان إذا سمع صوت الرعد لهى عن حديثه

RAZI:102:1/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r4.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r4.claim: Takāthur is boasting against others about abundance in wealth, status, and distinctions.
RAZI:102:1/r4.anchor: والتكاثر التباهي بكثرة المال والجاه والمناقب

RAZI:102:1/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r5.speaker: أبو مسلم
RAZI:102:1/r5.claim: Abū Muslim notes that the reciprocal pattern tafāʿul can express an exchange between two people, a deliberate effort to do something, or an action occurring intransitively.
RAZI:102:1/r5.anchor: وقال أبو مسلم : التكاثر تفاعل عن الكثرة والتفاعل يقع على أحد وجوه ثلاثة

RAZI:102:1/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r6.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r6.claim: The word may describe reciprocal rivalry, each person claiming more wealth and followers, or strenuous efforts by the ambitious to keep multiplying wealth.
RAZI:102:1/r6.anchor: ولفظ التكاثر في هذه الآية ويحتمل الوجهين الأولين

RAZI:102:1/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r7.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r7.claim: Al-Rāzī treats takāthur and tafākhur as synonymous and links the verse to the wording وتفاخر بينكم.
RAZI:102:1/r7.anchor: واعلم أن التفاخر والتكاثر شيء واحد ونظير هذه الآية قوله تعالى : { وتفاخر بينكم }

RAZI:102:1/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r8.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r8.claim: People boast about three ranks of felicity: the inward soul, the body, and what surrounds the body; inward felicity includes knowledge and virtuous character, bodily felicity includes health and beauty, and external goods include wealth, status, relatives, and friends.
RAZI:102:1/r8.anchor: وأجناس السعادة ثلاثة : ( فأحدها ) : في النفس ( والثانية ) : في البدن ( والثالثة ) : فيما يطيف بالبدن من خارج

RAZI:102:1/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r9.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r9.claim: The prayer attributed to Abraham for wisdom and joining the righteous exemplifies inward knowledge and virtue, through which enduring spiritual happiness is gained.
RAZI:102:1/r9.anchor: وهما المرادان بقوله حكاية عن إبراهيم : { رب هب لي حكما وألحقني بالصالحين } وبهما ينال البقاء الأبدي والسعادة السرمدية

RAZI:102:1/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r10.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r10.claim: External goods serve the body, while bodily health is sought to make time for lasting spiritual happiness; people will even sacrifice wealth and status to relieve bodily pain.
RAZI:102:1/r10.anchor: إذا تألم عضو من أعضائه فإنه يجعل المال والجاه فداء له

RAZI:102:1/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r11.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r11.claim: A wise person prioritizes higher felicities: boasting about wealth, status, helpers, and kin celebrates the lowest rank and diverts one from spiritual happiness through knowledge and action.
RAZI:102:1/r11.anchor: فالتفاخر بالمال والجاه والأعوان والأقرباء تفاخر بأخس المراتب من أسباب السعادات

RAZI:102:1/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r12.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r12.claim: The condemnation includes rivalry in numbers, money, status, relatives, supporters, armies, and every worldly pleasure and desire.
RAZI:102:1/r12.anchor: ويدخل فيه التكاثر بالعدد وبالمال والجاه والأقرباء والأنصار والجيش

RAZI:102:1/r13.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r13.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r13.claim: ألهاكم may be a statement about the audience or an interrogative rebuke, أألهاكم; Razi compares the interrogative reading with cited forms of أنذرتهم and إذا كنا عظاما.

RAZI:102:1/r14.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r14.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r14.claim: The verse condemns worldly rivalry, but reason shows that competition for real felicities is praiseworthy; rivalry is not blameworthy in every sense.
RAZI:102:1/r14.anchor: الآية دلت على أن التكاثر والتفاخر مذموم والعقل دل على أن التكاثر والتفاخر في السعادات الحقيقية غير مذموم

RAZI:102:1/r15.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r15.speaker: العباس وشيبة وعلي
RAZI:102:1/r15.claim: A report recounts al-ʿAbbās boasting of control of the water supply, Shayba of the key, and ʿAlī of cutting down unbelief with his sword; their distress was followed by revelation of the verse about watering pilgrims.
RAZI:102:1/r15.anchor: ومن ذلك ما روي من تفاخر العباس بأن السقاية بيده ، وتفاخر شيبة بأن المفتاح بيده إلى أن قال علي عليه السلام

RAZI:102:1/r16.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r16.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r16.claim: Al-Rāzī says a person may mention obedience and good character when he expects others to imitate him, citing the command to speak of God's favor.
RAZI:102:1/r16.anchor: أنه يجوز للإنسان أن يفتخر بطاعاته ومحاسن أخلاقه إذا كان يظن أن غيره يقتدي به

RAZI:102:1/r17.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r17.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r17.claim: Rivalry in knowledge, obedience, and good character is praiseworthy and a source of good; the condemned rivalry concerns worldly goods that hinder worship.
RAZI:102:1/r17.anchor: فثبت أن مطلق التكاثر ليس بمذموم ، بل التكاثر في العلم والطاعة والأخلاق الحميدة ، هو المحمود

RAZI:102:1/r18.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r18.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r18.claim: The definite article is not generic; it points to the familiar worldly multiplication of pleasures and attachments that distracts from God's worship, a known evil across reason and religions.
RAZI:102:1/r18.anchor: فالألف واللام في التكاثر ليسا للاستغراق ، بل للمعهود السابق ، وهو التكاثر في الدنيا ولذاتها وعلائقها

RAZI:102:1/r19.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r19.speaker: بنو سهم وبنو عبد مناف
RAZI:102:1/r19.claim: One reported occasion is a numbers contest between Banū Sahm and Banū ʿAbd Manāf: after counting living and dead members, Banū Sahm claimed the larger total.
RAZI:102:1/r19.anchor: نزلت في بني سهم وبني عبد مناف تفاخروا أيهم أكثر

RAZI:102:1/r20.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r20.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r20.claim: Razi sees the grave-visiting wording as matching a past rivalry; the rebuke asks what it would profit people even if they were more numerous.
RAZI:102:1/r20.anchor: لأن قوله : { حتى زرتم المقابر } يدل على أنه أمر مضى

RAZI:102:1/r23.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r23.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r23.claim: A second view identifies the rivalry as pursuit of wealth, supported by a report in which the Prophet recites the verse and explains what a person's wealth actually consists of.
RAZI:102:1/r23.anchor: مطرف بن عبد الله بن الشخير عن أبيه

RAZI:102:1/r30.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r30.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r30.claim: A third view says greed for wealth prevented people from paying financial obligations until death, when they finally bequeathed money for zakat and pilgrimage.
RAZI:102:1/r30.anchor: الحرص على المال وطلب تكثيره حتى منعتم الحقوق المالية إلى حين الموت

RAZI:102:1/r31.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r31.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r31.claim: A fourth view says rivalry turns hearts to stone, leaving only the small amount of religious feeling associated with visiting graves; Razi compares this with the rebuke that people give little thanks.
RAZI:102:1/r31.anchor: قلوبكم كأنها أحجار لا تنكسر البتة

RAZI:102:1/r32.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r32.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r32.claim: The verse leaves the object of ألهاكم unstated because an absolute construction intensifies blame and lets the mind supply every possible object.
RAZI:102:1/r32.anchor: المطلق أبلغ في الذم لأنه يذهب الوهم فيه كل مذهب

RAZI:102:1/r33.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r33.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r33.claim: The omitted object includes neglect of remembrance, duties, recommended acts, religious knowledge, worship, reflection, and contemplation.
RAZI:102:1/r33.anchor: ألهاكم التكاثر عن ذكر الله وعن الواجبات والمندوبات في المعرفة والطاعة والتفكر والتدبر

RAZI:102:1/r34.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r34.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r34.claim: Read against the preceding discussion of the Calamity, the verse means that worldly rivalry distracted people from contemplating it and preparing for it before death.
RAZI:102:1/r34.anchor: عن التدبر في أمر القارعة والاستعداد لها قبل الموت

RAZI:102:1/r35.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI:102:1/r35.speaker: author
RAZI:102:1/r35.claim: Read with the following grave-visitation clause, the verse means that rivalry made people forget the grave until they actually visited it.

BURHAN:v4p311/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p311/r6.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p311/r6.claim: كاد means nearly or came close; Zarkashi refers readers to his earlier discussion of verbs.
BURHAN:v4p311/r6.anchor: كاد بمعنى قارب وسبقت في مباحث الأفعال

ITQAN:v1p45/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p45/r7.speaker: ابن بريدة
ITQAN:v1p45/r7.claim: Although most say al-Takathur is Meccan, the author prefers Medinan, citing Ibn Burayda's report that it concerned two Ansari tribes boasting against each other.
ITQAN:v1p45/r7.anchor: سورة ألهاكم الأشهر أنها مكية ويدل لكونها مدنية وهو المختار ما أخرجه ابن أبي حاتم عن ابن بريدة أنها نزلت في قبيلتين من قبائل الأنصار تفاخروا الحديث

ITQAN:v1p45/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p45/r8.speaker: قتادة
ITQAN:v1p45/r8.claim: Qatada reports that al-Takathur was revealed concerning the Jews.
ITQAN:v1p45/r8.anchor: وأخرج عن قتادة أنها نزلت في اليهود

ITQAN:v1p45/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p45/r9.speaker: أبي بن كعب
ITQAN:v1p45/r9.claim: Ubayy ibn Kaʿb says they regarded the saying about Adam's son having a valley of gold as Qur'an until al-Takathur was revealed.
ITQAN:v1p45/r9.anchor: وأخرج البخاري عن أبي بن كعب قال كنا نرى هذا من القرآن يعني لو كان لابن آدم واد من ذهب حتى نزلت ﴿ ألهاكم التكاثر ﴾

ITQAN:v1p45/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p45/r10.speaker: علي
ITQAN:v1p45/r10.claim: Ali reports that they remained unsure about punishment in the grave until al-Takathur was revealed; the author notes that grave punishment is only mentioned in Medina in the authentic report about the Jewish woman.
ITQAN:v1p45/r10.anchor: وأخرج الترمذي عن علي قال ما زلنا نشك في عذاب القبر حتى نزلت وعذاب القبر لم يذكر إلا بالمدينة كما في الصحيح في قصة اليهودية

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r1.speaker: ابن فارس
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r1.claim: Ibn Faris says anything that occupies or distracts you has made you lahi; لهوت is from pastime and لهیت عن something means being diverted from it.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r1.anchor: قال ابن فارس : كل ما شغلك فقد ألهاك . ولهوت من اللهو . ولهيت عن الشيء ، إذا شغلت عنه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r2.claim: Ibn al-Zubayr would stop and turn away from his conversation when he heard thunder.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r2.anchor: وكان ابن الزبير : إذا سمع صوت الرعد لهي عن حديثه . أي : تركه وأعرض عنه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r3.claim: A lahwa is what a miller grinds by hand; its plural is lahā, and a gift is called a lahwa by analogy.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r3.anchor: واللهوة : ما يطحنه الطاحن في الرحى بيده . وجمعها : لهى ، وبذلك سميت العطية لهوة

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r4.claim: The lahāt is the fleshy part projecting toward the throat, or, in another view, the back of the mouth; its plural is lahā.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r4.anchor: واللهاة : لهاة الفم ، هي اللحمة المشرفة على الحلق . وقيل : بل هي أقصى الفم

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r10.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r10.claim: A sixth sense is occupation or prevention: hopes occupy people, and wealth and children can distract them from God's remembrance; the entry groups 102:1 here.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p534/r10.anchor: والسادس : الشغل والمنع . ومنه قوله تعالى في الحجر : ^ ( ويلههم الأمل ) ^ ، وفي المنافقين : ^ ( لا تلهكم أموالكم ولا أولادكم عن ذكر الله )

ITQAN:v4p537#2/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p537#2/r1.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
ITQAN:v4p537#2/r1.claim: In a mursal report, Zayd b. Aslam transmits the Prophet's expansion: rivalry in increase distracts from obedience until visiting the graves and death arrives.
ITQAN:v4p537#2/r1.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم مرسلا قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ( ألهاكم التكاثر عن الطاعة حتى زرتم المقابر
